payload.title: One editorial context for reporting agents and newsroom workers
payload.description:
As a Papyrus reporting or writing agent, I want one current publication-scoped editorial context, so that configurable policy reaches external agents and canned workers without duplicating evolving policy in static skills.

Approved scope: shared resolver/renderer for publication and optional section/story/assignment; structured CLI with explicit live versus local Git source, provenance/revisions, precedence/conflict warnings, truthful missing/unauthorized failures, required policies preserved under budgeting; same resolved content in research/reporting/copywriting workers; reuse Limatus packaged copy-edit skill while retaining explicit human option selection. Reconcile existing Python/GraphQL doctrine lookup rather than building a parallel store. No Cyclotron steering/delegation, infrastructure, credentials, deployment or main promotion.

Current evidence: newsroom.py papyrus_build_assignment_agent_context renders doctrine but loses source revision fields, suppresses read failures and mixes live section policy with assignment snapshots; researcher.tac's research harness loads Assignment without resolving doctrine. getAssignmentContext's TypeScript handler still chooses category-based desk doctrine while Python uses NewsroomSection. Existing YAML files are seeds, not proof of current hosted policy.

Milestones: canonical resolve/render/CLI and observable tests; shared worker integration and context-budget behavior; authorized API parity, skills and documentation. Code owner must verify missing/unauthorized behavior, revisions and required-policy preservation, with mocked scoped records and actual CLI local-file tests; live source/model calls are not required. Keep completed implementation reviewable in a draft PR and leave unimplemented acceptance explicit. No merge or deployment authorized.
